idea-plugin.name: Phantom Key-Value Console
idea-plugin.description: A key browser and console for Redis-compatible servers (Redis, Valkey, KeyDB…): keys found with SCAN and a pattern (never KEYS *), values of every type (strings with JSON indented, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams), delete, and a command line with redis-cli style output and history. Speaks the Redis protocol (RESP) itself, with password, ACL user, database and TLS. The connection opens only while the Redis tool window is shown.
